examples: `new Style` stores two values and calls nothing; a program makes a style with `Style::of`, whose examples show every way a style is used.
perf: `new Style` stores two values and calls nothing; `Style::of` builds one on every call, so its figure includes this one.
hostile: `new Style` stores two typed read-only values and calls nothing, so a wrong value does not compile; the names and text a user can give a style are checked in `Style::of`, whose attack sends them.
